Commentary.Commentary: That is it from this game then! Australia, the defending champions, make it through to the finals but the question is, who will they be facing? That will be decided, on the 24th of this month, it is a clash between South Africa and England. That game begins at 1830 IST (1300 GMT). Till then, goodbye and take care!

Meg Lanning says it was a great fightback! Admits they were not at their best. States they did not hit the right lengths, India came hard at them and they expected it to come down to the wire but she is pleased they came out on top in the clutch moments. Adds they were lucky in Kaur's wicket but they need such luck to in big games. Adds they were calm and composed, they love the big moments and they look forward to the finals.

Harmanpreet Kaur says the way they came back into the game was realy good but she did not expect them to lose. Adds her run out was unlucky but she is pleased they took this game till the last ball. Mentions the result was not in their favor but she is pleased with how the team played. Also says they love to chase, they wanted to chase and despite losing early wickets, they were backing themselves. Credits Jemimah Rodrigues for the way she played. Admits the fielding was not at its best but they can only learn from this and do well going ahead.

Ashleigh Gardner, PLAYER OF THE GAME, says she was very tensed bowling the last over. Adds the team showed a lot of character and fought back from a tough situation. Adds they started well with the bat but were not at their best with the ball. Informs she just wanted to bowl wicket to wicket and it went off well. Adds, it is great to spend some time in the middle and she was just trying to keep it simple and hit the ball well.
... PRESENTATION TIME ...

India will be disappointed with their fielding earlier on and that has proved to be the difference. The drop of Beth Mooney really cost them as it is because of her Australia got to a really good score. Also, there were quite a few misfield, India at least gave away 10 more runs than they should have and they lost just by the 5 runs. Yet again, India lose a game against the Aussies which they should have won.

For the Aussies, it was a tough day in the field but they showed great character and won the key moments. Darcie Brown along with Ashleigh Gardner were brilliant. The rest were quite on and off. What was surprising was the amount of extras Australia bowled but it did not cost them in the end.

India were first down and out at 3 down for not a lot inside the Powerplay. Jemimah Rodrigues and Harmanpreet Kaur then counter-attacked and turn the tide towards their side. Jemimah Rodrigues fell but Kaur continued along with Richa Ghosh! It came down to India needing around 40 in 34 and then, Kaur was run out in a very unfortunate manner. The Aussie bowlers then kept their cool and ensured it is them, who came out on top.

It is Australia yet again who manage to keep their calm and come out on top to march into yet another final! Have to say, this was India's game to lose. Not sure if you can call Harmanpreet Kaur's run out a fortunate one for the Aussies and an unfortunate one for India but that is what changed the game. However, what a second innings it was. It swung from one way to the another.
FOUR! It does not matter as it is a legal delivery! Australia make their way into yet another final! This is tossed up on off, it is hit over cover for a boundary. AUSTRALIA WIN BY 5 RUNS!
Shorter and on middle, this is pulled through square leg for one. 10 needed on the last ball. A legal delivery will mean Australia win.
OUT! TAKEN! Radha Yadav tries her best! She steps out and swings without getting close to the pitch of the ball but holes out to the fielder at long on. Ellyse Perry takes it.
Commentary.Howout: c Ellyse Perry b Ashleigh Gardner

Commentary.Commentary: Just the one! Deepti Sharma is off strike too! On off, this is hit towards mid off for one.
Two more! On off, this is hit wide of long on for a couple. India need boundaries.
Two! Fuller and outside off, this is hit through covers for two.
OUT! TIMBER! Jess Jonassen strikes! India left with a huge task in the last over. Sneh Rana steps out but fails to get to the pitch of the ball.She swings and misses and the ball hits the stumps.
Really full and on middle, Rana jams it out towards cover. Dots are gold at the moment.

That is outstanding fielding! Just magical. This is on middle, it is swept behind square on the leg side. The fielder makes a lot of ground to her right, Dives and pushes it back in. Saves two for her side.
Sneh Rana moves right across, this is fired down the leg side. She swings but misses. Not wided.
Another sweep, but Deepti Sharma is through the shot as it is bowled quite slow, it goes off the toe-end towards deep mid-wicket for one.
Slower through the air and on middle, this is swept through square leg for one.
On middle, this is hit down to long on for another single.
Another single as this is worked through square leg. Taking it deep are these two.
On off, this is pushed towards mid on for one.
FOUR! Out comes the slog sweep and it races away. India continue to fight! On middle, this is hit over mid-wicket and it races away into the fence.
Extras will help! Down the leg side. Sharma looks to sweep but misses, it hits the pad of the keeper and goes towards short fine leg for one.
Another single as this is pulled through square leg.
On middle, this is worked through square leg for one.
On middle, this is swept through square leg for one.

Leading edge but lands safe! On middle, this one lands and straightens a touch. Deepti Sharma looks to work it on the leg side but this goes off a soft leading edge but lands well short of the bowler.
FOUR! Slammed away! Shorter and outside off, this is hammered through covers and this one races away to the fence. Welcome boundary. A lot of this chase now depends on Deepti Sharma!
On middle, this is worked through square leg for one.
Shorter and outside off, this is played through covers for one more.
On off, this is pushed towards cover.

OUT! TAKEN! Darcie Brown gets another big wicket. That could well be the game for the Aussies. Richa Ghosh, the finisher for India departs now. On middle, Richa Ghosh looks to go big but this goes more off the splice towards deep mid-wicket. Tahlia McGrath makes no mistake. What an over from Darcie Brown. Also, not sure if taking on Darcie Brown was the right choice from Richa Ghosh!
Commentary.Howout: c Tahlia McGrath b Darcie Brown

Commentary.Commentary: Outstanding bowling! Length and on middle, this is mistimed towards mid on.
Not the best of shots there! This is short and outside off, Richa Ghosh looks to ramp it but misses. Another dot.
Just the one! Singles won't hurt Australia! On the pads, this is worked towards square leg for one.
The physio is out to have a look and he does the job. Deepti Sharma is fine to continue.
Ouch! That surely must have hurt! Shorter and on middle, Deepti Sharma is early in the pull, it hits her body and rolls on the off side. No run taken.
Good shot but for no runs! Fuller and on off, this is pushed to mid off. Dots are gold.
A single taken as this is eased down to long off.
Out comes the sweep, this is hit straight to short fine leg.

OUT! RUN OUT! Harmanpreet Kaur is short. That is so unfortunate. So very unfortunate. Harmanpreet Kaur is now gone. This game has swung yet again. This is on middle, it is swept hard through square leg. They take one. The fielder in the deep, runs to her right, dives and stops it. They go for the second. The throw is to the keeper who whips the bails off and appeasl. Kaur's bat got stuck in the ground as she tried to drag it. Replays roll in and they show that Kaur is short.
Big moment in the game! Harmanpreet Kaur's bat got stuck into the ground as she tried to ground it. Alyssa Healy is very confident.
Tossed up on middle, defended.
FOUR! Make that two in a row! Now just the 41 needed in 34. That is a poor ball. Down the leg side, this is swept fine on the leg side for a boundary.

FOUR! The pressure is not totally on the Aussie bowlers. That is not a good start to the over and India now should fancy this. Shorter and outside off, this is guided through point for another boundary.
FOUR! Richa Ghosh now joins the act! India back on top now. 49 needed in 36. This is full and outside off, this is lofted over cover for a boundary.
Shorter and on middle, this is pulled through mid-wicket for one.
FOUR! Carved away! A full one outside off, Harmanpreet Kaur makes room and carves it over point for a boundary. A welcome one.
Just the single from the Free HIt! On middle, this is heaved towards deep mid-wicket. The catch is taken but only one.
No ball! Tahlia McGrath has overstepped and a Free Hit coming up. On off, this is hit through covers for one.
Almost! A yorker outside off, Harmanpreet Kaur looks to jam it out but misses.
Fuller and on middle, this is clipped through mid-wicket for one.
A run as this is worked towards mid-wicket.

DROPPED! Alyssa Healy should have and would have taken that most of the times! That could well be a big, big miss as Harmanpreet Kaur gets a life! This is full and outside off, Harmanpreet Kaur walks across and then looks to heave it on the leg side but it goes off the outside edge to the right of the keeper who gets two hands but can't hang onto it.
Another short one, this is pulled through mid-wicket for one.
On off, this is pushed to cover.
On off, this is played through square leg for one.
On middle, Kaur plays it to mid-wicket.
A single to end then! On middle, this is hit down to long on for one.
A single now as this is played towards mid-wicket.
Two more! This is fuller and on off again, Richa Ghosh hits it wide of long off for a couple.
Two! Fuller and outside off, this is lofted over cover for two.
Flatter and on off, this is pushed to cover.
On middle, this is worked through square leg for one.
Fired down the leg side. The keeper fails to take it cleanly. A run taken.
A single as this is pulled through square leg.
On off, defended.
On off, defended.
Good length and around off, this is pushed to cover.

OUT! TAKEN! That is the wicket Australia needed and it is Darcie Brown who provides it. This stand was taking the game away but Darcie Brown strikes. This is short, first real short ball by the Aussies. Jemimah Rodrigues looks to upper cut it but it goes off the face and into the hands of Alyssa Healy. Australia will be very pleased. They are back on top. Excellent innings from Jemimah Rodrigues but they needed her to stay longer.
Commentary.Howout: c Alyssa Healy b Darcie Brown

Commentary.Commentary: FOUR! That is wonderful! What timing again! Jemimah Rodrigues is in some touch! This is full and outside off, Jemimah Rodrigues leans into it and strokes it through covers for a boundary.

DRINKS! This is a brilliant partnership for India. They were down and out at three down for nothing but these two have added 65 in no time and one can say, India have their noses ahead here slightly. Australia on the other hand, are under a little pressure, they need to break this stand or the game could well slip away quickly.
A single to end another top over for India! On middle, this is swept through mid-wicket for one.
Two more! On the pads, this is hit through square leg for two.
FOUR! Second in the over! India are racing along now. This is tossed up outside off again, this is lofted over cover for another boundary.
Now the sweep comes out, it is hit through square leg and it races away to the fence.
Good sensible batting as this is now worked down to long on for one.
FOUR! Up and over! That is glorious! Probably the shot of this innings. Tossed up on off, this is lofted over cover for a boundary.
A single to end! On the pads, this is nudged towards mid-wicket for one.
Another single as this is clipped through mid-wicket.
On off, this is hit through covers for one more.
Flatter and on off, this is guided towards point for one.
Out comes the sweep, it is played in the gap in the square leg region for two.
Slower through the air and on off, defended.
9 from the over then! These two going along well! Fuller and on middle, this is pushed down to long on for one.
On middle, this is worked through mid-wicket for one more.
Another single as this is pushed down to long on.
Yet another single as this is nudged towards mid-wicket.
Now takes one as this is worked through square leg.
FOUR! Cheeky! This is brilliant! Walks across, Megan Schutt goes full and on middle, this is paddle scooped fine and into the fine leg fence.
Six singles in the over then! On the pads, this is swept through square leg for one.
Six singles in the over then! On the pads, this is hit through square leg for one.
Another single as this is pushed down to long on.
On middle, this is swept through square leg for one.
Outside off again, this is played towards point for one more.
Shorter and around off, this is guided towards point for one.
Another single as this is nudged on the leg side for one.
Now takes one as this is worked through square leg.
SIX! That is a long hit! A strong hit! Harmanpreet Kaur uses her feet, gets to the pitch of the ball and hits it over long on for a biggie. Top shot.
On middle, this is hit down to long on for one.
On off, this is pushed through covers for one.
Two more! Outside off, shorter, this is played through point for two.
WIDE! Slips this one down the leg side. Wided.
On off, blocked. End of a really good over for India.
Angled into the pads, this is nudged on the leg side for one.
On middle, this is worked down to fine leg for one.
FOUR! Second boundary in the over! The run rate is fine for India but the wicket column is a problem! On middle, this is worked through mid-wicket for a boundary.
WIDE! Shorter and well outside off, Harmanpreet Kaur looks to cut but misses.
Outside off, this is guided through point for one.
FOUR! Takes full toll of the Free Hit! Fuller and on off, this is hit hard down the ground towards long off for a boundary.
NO BALL! Outside off, this is guided down to third man for one.
On off, this is pushed towards cover for one.
FOUR! That is glorious! Just glorious! A length ball outside off, Harmanpreet Kaur opens the face of the bat and carves it through point for a boundary.

OUT! RUN OUT! That is the last thing India would have wanted at the moment! Total confusion! On off, this is worked towards mid-wicket and Yastika Bhatia takes off. Jemimah Rodrigues is not interested and sends her back. She is at the point of no return. Grace Harris picks the ball up and throws it to Alyssa Healy who takes the bails off.
On the pads, this is clipped towards mid-wicket.
On middle, defended.
Another wide! Shorter and well wide outside off. Wided.
Good length and on off, defended.
Another wide! This is well outside off, left alone.
WIDE! Down the leg side. Wided.
On off, defended.
Two more! On middle, this is worked through mid-wicket for two.
FOUR! Through the off side this time. Brilliant timing again! Tossed up outside off, this is hit through covers for another boundary.
FOUR! That is wonderfully played! Nice way to get off the mark! On the pads, this is swept through square leg for a boundary.

Australia review now! An aappeal for LBW turned down but Australia review. OUT! Another massive wicket as Ball Tracker shows three reds. Brilliant use of the review from the Aussies. Flatter and on middle, Smriti Mandhana goes back to defend. It seems to have hit both bat and pad. An appeal but turned down. Australia decide to review. Replays show it is pad first. India in huge trouble now.
Flatter and on off, defended.
A dot to end a successful first by Megan Schutt! On off, this is defended.
FOUR! Up and over! Off the mark in style! Fuller and around off, Yastika Bhatia lofts it over cover for a boundary.
Fuller and on off, this is pushed down to mid off.

A long shout for an LBW and the finger is raised. Shafali Verma reviews but that seems to be clipping leg at least. No bat involved/ OUT! It is clipping the leg pole. Shafali Verma can consider herself a touch unlucky but she has to walk off. Australia get the wicket they would have wanted as Shafali Verma looked good in her short stay. This starts from outside off and tails back in. Shafali Verma walks across and looks to flick but misses and gets hit on the pads. An appeal and the finger is raised. Shafali Verma reviews but in vain. India dealt a blow early on.
BEATEN! Fuller and outside off, Shafali Verma looks to drive but is beaten.
Fuller and outside off, this is driven through covers for one.
FOUR! Swept and done so brilliantly! That is a really good first over for India. This is tossed up on middle, Shafali Verma goes down on one knee and nails it through square leg for a boundary.
Another couple for Shafali Verma! On middle, this is worked through mid-wicket for two more.
Smriti Mandhana now is off the mark! On middle, this is worked through mid-wicket for one more.
Straightaway looks to play the sweep but this goes off the inner half towards short fine leg.
Another one tossed up on middle, this is pushed down to long on for one.
Shafali Verma and India are underway! On middle, this is worked through mid-wicket for two.
